title: Teleology is an emergent relational property of living systems

statements.text: Autopoietic organization makes no reference to ends or purposes, but sense-making belongs to the coupling of a concrete autopoietic system with its environment. Teleology is therefore not an intrinsic organizational property but an emergent relational one, the intrinsic teleology of Weber and Varela.

sources.quote: teleology is not an intrinsic organizational property, but an emergent relational one
